questions.question: How should auth-service issue and validate sessions: stateless signed JWTs in httpOnly cookies, or opaque session tokens stored in Postgres and validated by lookup?
questions.default: Stateless JWT (access token) in an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie, short-lived (15 min) with a longer-lived refresh token cookie, validated by conversation-service via a shared JWT secret/JWKS endpoint on auth-service

questions.question: What is the access/refresh token expiry policy?
questions.default: Access token 15 minutes, refresh token 7 days, refresh rotates on use

questions.question: Where are uploaded chat attachments stored?
questions.default: On a local filesystem volume mounted into conversation-service (./data/uploads), referenced by path/metadata in Postgres; no object storage service for this scope

questions.question: What password policy should registration enforce?
questions.default: Minimum 8 characters, at least one letter and one number

questions.question: What CI platform should the pipeline target?
What unit/integration test coverage target should CI enforce?
questions.default: 80% line coverage on services and packages/ui business logic, enforced via Vitest coverage thresholds in CI

questions.question: Which default Ollama model should docker-compose pre-pull for local development/E2E tests?
questions.default: llama3.2:1b (small, fast to pull and run in CI/local containers)

questions.question: What header name should carry the request correlation ID between client, shell, and services?
questions.default: X-Correlation-Id, generated by the shell if absent and propagated by both services in logs and responses
